Problem Statement
You are given a 2D grid of size n \times m, representing a map of tasks. Each cell (i, j) contains an integer A[i][j]:
If A[i][j] > 0, it represents the time required to complete the work at that specific grid cell.
If A[i][j] = 0, the cell is empty (no work is required, but it can be traversed).
You start from a given starting position (or choose your starting position depending on the variant) and can move to any adjacent cell (up, down, left, right).
Each movement between two adjacent cells costs a fixed time of 2 units, regardless of whether the target cell has work or is empty (0).
To complete the work at a cell, you must spend the full work time specified by A[i][j] at that cell. Work at a cell is completed only once.
Your objective is to find the minimum total time required to visit and complete the work across the required cells

You are given a string N. Your task is to reverse the string while keeping the spaces in their original positions, followed by the total count of the words in the string.

A single line contains an input string N.

1 <= N <= 10^6

A single line containing the modified string, and the word count at the end.

my name is doselect

Reverse the characters of the string without changing the positions of the spaces.

10 seconds

You are given an n x n chessboard with the positions of a knight and a queen.

- Diagonally

Question 1: Fruit Into Baskets
You are given an integer array fruits where fruits[i] represents the type of fruit at position i.

You have two baskets, and each basket can hold only one type of fruit. You can collect fruits starting from any index, but you must collect them from consecutive positions.

Find the maximum number of fruits you can collect such that you have at most two distinct types of fruits.

Example: Input: fruits = [1, 2, 1, 2, 3]

Output: 4

Explanation: The subarray [1, 2, 1, 2] contains only two distinct fruit types. Hence, the maximum number of fruits is 4.
